sentence: This project studies how gels made from fat-based molecules form in place when two liquids come into contact and what controls their stability.
This project develops a data-driven way to design polymers that combine electronic conductivity with ionic transport for electronic devices.
This project studies how a chemical group called trityl can carry small molecules and release them under mild conditions.
This project designs ways for groups of agents to learn together while resisting attacks, protecting privacy and coping with communication delays.
This project builds a web-based system with AI coaching where forensic examiners and prosecutors work through simulated cyber incidents.
This project builds integrated cyber-physical systems that can explain their decisions to the field operators who use them.
This project builds a tool that measures electron spin in just a few hundred molecules at room temperature.
This project brings together experts to lay out challenges and a plan for designing efficient computing systems built from chiplets.
This project tests how well the parts of a cybersecurity education program work.
This project builds wireless networks that use optical vision and machine learning to improve reliability and to make images.
This project develops a scalable way to make printable glass using lasers and computer modeling.
This project explores the structure and properties of electronic materials and the nanofabrication processes used for computer chips.
This project develops a simpler way to make hydrogels with tiny structures by using a natural process where two liquids separate.
This project develops camera-based measurements and fiber optic sensors to track how unsaturated soil moves and how air and water pressure change inside it.
This project develops ways to automatically check whether augmented reality guidance is clear, correct, safe and suited to the real setting.
This project gets a mass spectrometer that lets researchers in many fields study proteins in depth.
This project studies how a toxin in the lungfish genome helps form a skin cocoon when the animal goes dormant.
